audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Jax level 1 at 8/10 while whys[0] says 'Level 1 is even'; gives Skill at 4-5 and first item while whys[3] and whys[5] both say Jax out-trades him there; and gives Jax the 2+ items row while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Yorick out-scales and owns the side lane.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Yorick) matches the prose and the 55.48% win rate. Jax owns 2 through first item on Counter Strike against an auto-and-ghoul damage pattern, and loses once Maiden of the Mist is permanent.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Yorick across both layers as one atomic group, ratings adjusted, phases[6].why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate is written "Grandmaster at Arms" in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid.
audit.why: The ability is Grandmaster's Might, 110/100/90s. Yorick's own R is Eulogy of the Isles at 160s rank 1 — a very long first cooldown that the page never uses.
audit.corrected: Renamed in all three content strings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is described as a cage that 'traps you for the ghouls', with no cooldown and without the interaction that actually matters: it creates terrain.
audit.why: The kit flags it as terrain — it blocks paths and dashes — so it does not merely trap you, it denies Leap Strike as an escape route and can block the leap itself. It is 20s at rank 1 down to 12s at rank 5, against Leap Strike's 8s, so there is a real window every time he spends it. Mourning Mist is 12s at rank 1 and reduces armor as well as marking you for the swarm, which the page never mentions.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now names the 20s cooldown and the fact that it blocks Leap Strike; whys[3] and mid carry Mourning Mist's 12s timer.

edits.before: This is your window. Counter Strike is tailor-made for Yorick — it eats his auto-heavy ghoul DPS and the recast stuns him — so bait his E-mark, leap in, and grind. At 6 the Grandmaster at Arms Armor/MR steroid plus your third-hit on-hit turns the all-in lethal even through the ghouls; force it while his Dark Procession is on cooldown so he can't wall you in. One rule: never sit inside his mist with his W up, or the ghouls chunk you while you're caged.
edits.after: This is your window. Counter Strike is tailor-made for Yorick — it eats his auto-heavy ghoul DPS and the recast stuns him — so bait his 12s Mourning Mist mark, leap in, and grind. At 6 the Grandmaster's Might Armor/MR steroid plus your third-hit on-hit turns the all-in lethal even through the ghouls; force it while Dark Procession is on its 20s cooldown. That wall is real terrain: it blocks Leap Strike, so caged means no leap out and the ghouls chunk you at their leisure.

notes: Dark Procession is terrain, not just a cage — it blocks Leap Strike itself, which is the single most important thing about this matchup for a Jax player and was nowhere on the page. Now in dosFull[0].d and mid. Mourning Mist also reduces armor per Riot's text, which no string mentions; I put its cooldown on the page but not the armor shred, since I could not confirm the amount and a bare 'shreds armor' adds little without it — flagging it as the obvious next addition. Unlike jax vs yone, the early Executioner's Calling advice here is correct and was left in place.
